ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Asymmetric intensity; left lobe is approximately 85% low-intensity black, while the right lobe presents a high-contrast mix of approximately 60% high-intensity white and 40% low-intensity black spotting.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains a dominant black field with sparse white mottling along the distal trailing edge. Right lobe features a high-intensity white substrate populated by dense, non-contiguous black circular and elliptical blobs (mottling) concentrated in the medial and distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a calculated angle of approximately 55 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern. Left lobe trailing edge exhibits small, jagged peaks (3-7 pixel amplitude). Right lobe shows more pronounced, irregular undulations and a significant step-down notch near the lateral tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the medial trailing edge transitioning into a convex sweep towards the distal lateral tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-contrast, raised tan/white circular structures (barnacle colonization) localized on the far-left lateral tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Presence of multiple vertical and diagonal light-grey linear streaks (rake marks) cutting across the low-intensity black field of the central-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle clusters on the left fluke tip; irregular missing tissue/indentation on the extreme right lateral trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique high-density 'dalmatian' spotting pattern localized exclusively to the right lobe's white field.
